objective: Replace a fixed-threshold demonstration rule with versioned synthetic decision routing, without authorizing money movement.
problem_boundary: Local offline EUR approval eligibility in a synthetic brownfield transaction-processing lab.
invariants: Unknown risk or invalid amounts cannot be automatically eligible.
High risk and cross-border transactions always require human review.
An old idempotency key must never silently pick up a later rule version.
Only explicitly configured department/currency policies can yield automatic eligibility.

acceptance.text: EUR 3000 Treasury LOW domestic is eligible under both policies.
EUR 4000 Treasury LOW domestic is eligible in v1 but requires review in v2.
Any HIGH risk synthetic request requires human review.
Any cross-border synthetic request requires human review.
Replaying a request with the same idempotency key returns the original decision and policy version.
Changing the payload under an existing key or reusing a transaction ID under another key returns a conflict.

allowed_execution: Sandbox/local, synthetic data, no external network, no secrets, no deployment
change_policy: Requirements changes create a new INT-xxx delta with impact graph and re-verification; old policy decisions are retained.
evidence_warning: Illustrative document, not proof of an actual policy-owner approval.
